whenToUse: A paediatric or family clinic that wants a friendly, illustrated tone and a check-up schedule by birth date.
Practices that speak to parents and children, with a picture story and read-aloud.
avoidWhen: An adult or general practice — use site-clinic-01.
A preschool or nursery — use site-preschool-01.
a11y: Check-up results and booking summary use aria-live; errors use role="alert"; page turns support the keyboard and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Keep read-aloud optional and never autoplay it.
